400.description:
The request cannot be processed. Problem types: `idempotency-key-required`, `idempotency-key-invalid`,
`malformed-request`, `invalid-limit`, `invalid-cursor` and `unknown-query-parameter`.

type.description: Problem type slug: the shared `not-found`, `illegal-transition`, `concurrent-update` and `validation-failed`, or one slug per `Err...` name of this context, for example `ack-window-closed`.

409.description:
The write conflicts with the state of the purchase order, the vendor or the aggregate version. Problem types:
`already-acknowledged` (`ErrAlreadyAcknowledged`), `ack-window-closed`
(`ErrAckWindowClosed`), `label-before-acceptance` (`ErrLabelBeforeAcceptance`),
`confirm-without-label` (`ErrConfirmWithoutLabel`), `vendor-suspended`
(`ErrVendorSuspended`), `illegal-transition` (a write against a state the model
gives no `Err...` for) and `concurrent-update` (optimistic-concurrency
conflict; the caller re-reads and retries) and `idempotency-key-reused` (the `Idempotency-Key` was
already used with a different method, path or body).

type.description: Problem type slug: the shared `not-found`, `illegal-transition`, `concurrent-update` and `validation-failed`, or one slug per `Err...` name of this context, for example `ack-window-closed`.

422.description:
The request is malformed or breaks a validation rule. Problem types:
`validation-failed`, `partial-acknowledgement` (`ErrPartialAcknowledgement`) and
`ack-window-out-of-range` (`ErrAckWindowOutOfRange`).
